title: A Wiener-process-based degradation model with a recursive filter algorithm for remaining useful life estimation
authors: Xiao-Sheng Si; Wenbin Wang; Chang-Hua Hu; Mao-Yin Chen; Dong-Hua Zhou
reliability_note: Publisher full article preview consulted; stochastic Wiener drift updated by recursive filter and EM, first-hitting-time RUL distribution under assumed known failure threshold; gyro case only.
